title: Turkey Burgers
instructions: Mix all ingredients for 5 minutes, form 2 wide patties, air fry at 190°C for 11–13 min, flipping halfway.
notes: Add lettuce, tomato, and onion as a bun alternative if desired.

title: Veggie Burger (Mushrooms Only)
instructions: Chop mushrooms finely, mix with egg, breadcrumbs, and spices. Form patties and cook on a pan until golden.
notes: Can add other vegetables or seasonings as preferred.

title: Oats Protein Breakfast
instructions: Mix oats with water, cook or soak, then stir in protein powder.

title: Chicken & Rice Lunch
instructions: Cook chicken and rice separately, combine and drizzle olive oil.

title: Post-Workout Chicken & Potato
instructions: Cook chicken and potatoes separately, combine and drizzle olive oil.

title: Evening Skyr & Eggs
instructions: Mix skyr with cooked eggs and drizzle olive oil.
